title: Phishing Investigation
story: Employees received phishing emails. Students analyze headers, attachments, and links to determine legitimacy.

tasks.title: Analyze Email Headers
tasks.description: Inspect email headers for routing, sender, and authentication evidence.
tasks.hint: Review Received, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC fields.

tasks.title: Identify Spoofing
tasks.description: Determine whether the sender identity was spoofed.
tasks.hint: Compare From, Return-Path, and authentication results.

tasks.title: Extract IOC
tasks.description: Extract malicious links, domains, attachments, or sender indicators.

tasks.title: Block Malicious Domains
tasks.description: Block phishing domains in the appropriate security control.
tasks.hint: Add malicious domains to DNS or web filtering controls.

tasks.title: Write Incident Summary
tasks.description: Summarize phishing evidence and recommended actions.
tasks.hint: Include affected users, IOCs, and containment steps.
